general.title: Pro Shop’s Chad Mumm on Skins Game Return To Prime Video
general.summary: “The Farmers Insurance Skins Game” returns to Prime video this Friday for a second year in a row. This year’s event features PGA tour veterans and rookies vying for chance to win $4 million at the Atlantic Field Clubs in Florida. Chad Mumm, Co-Founder and President of the golf media and commerce company Pro Shop, joined Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick to discuss the revival of the iconic game and what’s different this year. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Balsam Hill CEO on Christmas Tree Shopping Outlook
general.summary: Mac Harman, CEO and Founder of Balsam Hill, says the company saw strong interest early in the season, but some consumers appear to be holding off, possibly until the coming weekend. Customers who shop online are completing purchases. Harman says Balsam Hill serves shoppers across income levels: many save for its lifelike trees, while ornaments and other accessories tend to appeal to more premium buyers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

Still in Early Innings of AI Adoption: PSP’s Momei Qu
general.summary: Momei Qu, Managing Director and Head of Venture at PSP Growth, says Anthropic is in a period of price discovery as public-market investors work out how to value a frontier AI company. Compared with SaaS predecessors, Anthropic may offer faster growth and a larger addressable market, but investors are weighing substantial capital expenditure, uncertain long-term margins and questions about its competitive moat. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg

general.title: Financials, Healthcare Will Be Big AI Winners: Yardeni
general.summary: Ed Yardeni, President and Chief Investment Strategist at Yardeni Research, described the market’s sharp intraday reversal as another attempt to find a bottom, following recent steep losses and Monday’s dramatic rebound. He pointed to support around 69,077,000 as transcribed, and said dip buyers were stepping in at these levels. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Asian Stocks Rise as Tech Gains in Taiwan, Korea: Markets Wrap
general.summary: Asian stocks gained as a late recovery on Wall Street brought some stability to markets, following a flight to Treasuries driven by doubts over the artificial intelligence trade.
